claims.text: Compression reduces the size of a file, so it takes less storage space and takes less time to transmit; the speed of the connection is set by the connection and does not change.

verification.method: Authored originally for 9618 AS under standard v0.2.0-draft. Requires semantic review (RS-28).

claims.text: Files are compressed to save storage space, to shorten the time a file takes to send or stream, and to reduce the volume of data where data is paid for.

verification.method: Authored originally for 9618 AS under standard v0.2.0-draft. Requires semantic review (RS-28).

claims.text: Lossy compression permanently removes some of the data, so the original file cannot be rebuilt exactly from the compressed file.

verification.method: Authored originally for 9618 AS under standard v0.2.0-draft. Requires semantic review (RS-28).

claims.text: Lossless compression records the same data in fewer bits, so the original file can be rebuilt exactly from the compressed file.

verification.method: Authored originally for 9618 AS under standard v0.2.0-draft. Requires semantic review (RS-28).

claims.text: A compression method is justified by what the file is for: lossy suits photographs and sound, where discarded detail passes unnoticed, and lossless suits text and data files, where every value must be restored exactly.

verification.method: Authored originally for 9618 AS under standard v0.2.0-draft. Requires semantic review (RS-28).

claims.text: Run-length encoding is a lossless method that replaces a run of repeated items with the item and the length of the run.

verification.method: Authored originally for 9618 AS under standard v0.2.0-draft. Requires semantic review (RS-28).

claims.text: Run-length encoding compresses a bitmap well when the image has long runs of same-coloured pixels, and compresses poorly when neighbouring pixels differ, because the run-and-count pairs then take more space than the codes they replace.

verification.method: Authored originally for 9618 AS under standard v0.2.0-draft. Requires semantic review (RS-28).

claims.text: A photograph is compressed with a lossy method that discards detail the eye is least sensitive to, and sound is compressed with a method that discards what the ear is least sensitive to.

verification.method: Authored originally for 9618 AS under standard v0.2.0-draft. Requires semantic review (RS-28).

claims.text: Text is compressed with lossless methods because every character matters, and a vector graphic, already stored as a short list of objects, usually needs no further compression of that kind.

verification.method: Authored originally for 9618 AS under standard v0.2.0-draft. Requires semantic review (RS-28).
